title: Normalized-density event TV and Hellinger affinity
source_anchor: Generic library theorem for two genuine normalized nonnegative measurable integrable densities on a common arbitrary measure space. Gaussian source B.2.3 Ex68/69 motivates upper comparison; Ex72 TV/min/affinity comparison motivates lower comparison. General carrier is an explicitly authored library generalization, not attributed as a source theorem. Existing actual Gaussian target signature remains unchanged.
target_statement:
theorem normalized_density_tv_affinity {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (μ : Measure α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (hf0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    (hfm : Measurable f) (hgm : Measurable g)
    (hfi : Integrable f μ) (hgi : Integrable g μ)
    (hf1 : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = 1) (hg1 : (∫ x, g x ∂μ) = 1) :
    let a : ℝ := ∫ x, Real.sqrt (f x * g x) ∂μ
    let δ : ℝ := sSup {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Set α, MeasurableSet B ∧
      z = |(∫ x in B, f x ∂μ) - (∫ x in B, g x ∂μ)|}
    Integrable (fun x => Real.sqrt (f x * g x)) μ ∧
    0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1 ∧
    δ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∫ x, |f x - g x| ∂μ) ∧
    1 - a ≤ δ ∧ δ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - a ^ 2)
